tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that adds the transient measurements needed to separate coupling from relaxation and meet the mechanism note's minimum of eight rows before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements for five parameters at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly distinguish coupling strength from memory relaxation.
It does not resolve the coupling and memory-timescale ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit Kelvin–Voigt creep or a damped oscillator
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither supplied model accounts for the observed gradient suppression and history-conditioned lag.
